s: Major policies should be set nationally so rules are the same everywhere, even if some states disagree.

national_vs_state_tradeoff.torn: I weigh national standards and state control about equally.

s: The federal government solves problems like roads, schools and public health better, even if it's far from local conditions.
I lean toward the federal government solving these problems.
I lean toward state and local governments solving these problems.
State and local governments solve these problems better, even if some lack money or expertise.

states_differ: This should be the same nationwide: {case}.

States should override city laws only where one statewide rule is clearly needed.
Cities should be able to set their own rules on these things, without states overriding them.
grant_conditions: The federal government should be able to withhold money from states over any policy it chooses.
The federal government can attach conditions only about how that money is spent.
Federal money to states should come with no conditions; states spend it as they see fit.
grant_conditions_cases: The federal government shouldn't be able to cut a state's or city's funding for this: {case}.
The federal government should be able to cut a state's or city's funding for this: {case}.
state_refusal: States must help enforce federal laws, even ones they disagree with.
States can decline to use their own police and resources on federal laws, but can't block federal agents.
States can refuse to help and pass laws blocking federal enforcement within their borders.
state_refusal_cases: States should be able to refuse to help enforce this: {case}.

s: When it's unclear what works, the country should pick one national approach based on the best evidence, even if states can't try alternatives.
